recommendations.body: `TestMaterializeMode::test_selected_materialize_preflight_refusal_records_requested_id_without_phase` in `tests/cli/test_roadmap_cmd.py` (step 4 “Give selected and all-eligible --materialize commands one lifecycle”) omits the nonrecoverable explicit-ID selection path, so the required `preflight-refused` lifecycle and snapshot cleanup are unprotected for current/duplicate rows
